ctx.x: So those were your two students and for the rest of the people you wrote Hand­ in-Hand with Hannon.

Well, yeah, that was a brainstorm of mine and it worked out pretty good, it turned out to be a good clarinet exercise book. And what I did was transcribed Hannon’s exercise, about twelve of them, in every key for the clarinet. Turns out to be a good study for clarinetists. I get letters from time to time from a lot of excellent clarinetists that use that as a part of their studies.
And was that something that you had done yourself as your practice routine and then decided to…
